final: WITH j AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), c AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.tradekind, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM s, a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
